query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS "count: i64"
            FROM
                chat c
            INNER JOIN
                message m
            ON
                c.chat_id = m.chat_id
                AND m.sender_user_uuid IS NULL
                AND m.timestamp > c.last_read
                AND m.status != ?1
            WHERE
                c.is_incoming
                AND NOT c.is_confirmed_connection
                AND c.status = ?3
                AND (c.muted_until IS NULL OR c.muted_until <= ?2)
